title: DDMM manifest.json (V1)
description: Schema for a Helldivers 2 mod manifest.json using the V1 format, matching src-tauri/src/models/manifest.rs::v1::Manifest.

Version.description: Manifest format version. Must be the integer 1.

Guid.description: The mod's stable, unique identifier. Keep this the same across versions of the mod.

IconPath.description: Path to an icon image, relative to the mod's root folder. Matched case-insensitively on disk.

NexusData.description: Legacy Nexus Mods identification, still read for backwards compatibility. Prefer Sources for new manifests.

Sources.description: Provider-neutral declarations of where this mod can be found. See docs/authors/sources.md.

Include.description: Paths (relative to the mod root) whose patch files are deployed when this option is toggled on.

Image.description: Path to a preview image, relative to the mod's root folder.

Provider.description: Free-form, lowercase-normalized. Well-known values: nexus, modworkshop, github, gamebanana, url. Any other string is accepted.

Id.description: Provider-specific mod ID, used to build that provider's page URL when Url is absent.

Url.description: Explicit page URL. Always takes precedence over an auto-generated one when present.

Version.description: The version of the mod available at this source, if known.
